review:
Joker Queen combines a classic fruit theme with a mysterious queen. It has 40 paylines, and its main feature is triggered when three Joker Queens land on reels 2, 3 and 4 in the base game.

That unlocks a series of respins in which the queen expands and acts as a wild on her reels throughout all respin rounds, creating wins across many lines. Respin, bonus buy and Chance x2 features are all tied to this theme. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 1,172x maximum, a relatively low cap, and the RTP is 95.87%. A good fit for players who like fruit slots with one clear, recurring feature.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
